TokSmart desktop UI components

desktop-components.js is bundled with esbuild 0.28.2. To rebuild it, install
the three pinned packages below and esbuild@0.28.2 in a temporary working
directory and save this entry module as desktop-components.entry.mjs:

    import '@github/tab-container-element';
    export { default as copy } from 'copy-to-clipboard';
    export { waapi } from 'animejs/waapi';

Run this command from that directory and copy the output to web/vendor/:

    npx esbuild desktop-components.entry.mjs --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2020 --banner:js='/* Third-party bundle. Versions, build instructions and licenses in NOTICE.txt. */' --outfile=desktop-components.js
